teams.note: Club's 2026 Watch/Listen page, 'How to Listen' section: iHeartRadio (English), KFWB 980AM (Espanol), KWKW 1330AM (Espanol). The iHeart page calls itself the 'Official Audio Home of Angel City FC'. No per-match audio list was shown.
2026 How to Watch page lists TV/streaming only (ESPN, ION, NWSL+, CBS, Prime, Roku). No radio partner found on the site or in its sitemap.
No radio or audio partner found on the club site (home, matchday, and a sitemap scan of about 540 pages). TV only as far as found.
2026 match-preview 'where to watch' posts list TV only (e.g. CBS Sports Network). The club has a local TV deal with FOX Chicago. No radio partner found in a scan of about 1,400 sitemap URLs.
2026 Ways to Watch page lists TV/streaming only. Spanish is on ESPN Deportes (TV), not radio. No radio partner found.
The local partner is MSG Networks, which is TV (2025 renewal; a Victory+ regional deal also appears in the sitemap). No radio or audio partner found on the club site.

The Dash How to Watch page (labelled 2025 season) lists TV/streaming only (Prime, ION, CBSSN/Paramount+, NWSL+). The Dynamo /radiostream page (hdfc.radio on Mixlr) is not tied to the Dash on any page found.
The 2026 schedule page shows 'Listen: KC Current Radio' on every match, but the link is a disabled placeholder (href=/broken). No station, frequency or stream URL could be confirmed.
No radio or audio partner found on the club site (home, matchday, partners, and a sitemap of about 100 pages). No how-to-watch page exists.
The Pride site (orlandocitysc.com/pride) schedule and sitemap show no radio or audio listing. orlandopride.com did not resolve. No radio partner found.

stations.freq: HD2 subchannel (FM frequency not stated by source)

teams.note: 2026: 'All Thorns matches for 2026 will be available for listening on KNKR-2 (KNRK-HD2) through Audacy.' The page spells it KNKR-2 in that sentence but KNRK-2 in the schedule. No direct Audacy URL is given.

Mar 12 2026 renewal: Sports Talk 790AM is the primary home for all 30 regular-season games, with select games on Talk Radio 1080. Both stream on the iHeartRadio app, 790louisville.com and talkradio1080.com. Call letters come from the station sites (790louisville.iheart.com = WKRD; talkradio1080.iheart.com = WKJK). The club releases give brand names only, and no source states the 1080 band.
'How to Watch Wave FC in 2026' lists TV/streaming only (Victory+, Prime, ION, CBS, ESPN, NWSL+, Roku, KUSI local TV). No radio partner found in the sitemap.

2026 release (Apr 16 2026): 11 select matches (Apr 26 vs UTA through Sep 6 vs SD) on Sports Radio 950 KJR AM, streaming on the iHeartRadio app. Announcers: Jackson Felts, Stephanie Verdoia, Kwame Appiah. Not every match is carried, and the 2026 radio schedule ended Sep 6. No direct stream URL is given; sportsradiokjr.iheart.com now redirects to 933kjr.iheart.com (KJR-FM).
The 2026 schedule lists broadcasters per match (Victory+, ION, CBSSN, NWSL+, with KMYU local TV). No radio or audio is listed and none was found in the rsl.com sitemap.

The 2026 How to Watch page lists TV/streaming only. The club had ESPN 630 AM (DC) radio for 13 matches in 2024 (https://washingtonspirit.com/blog/2024/05/15/washington-spirit-announces-the-clubs-first-ever-radio-partnership/), plus a 2024 playoff radio broadcast. No 2025 or 2026 radio confirmation was found.

league_audio.name: NWSL+
league_audio.what: The league's free streaming app (iOS/Android, Apple TV, Fire TV, Roku). It is video, not audio-only. The 2026 how-to-watch pages list no audio-only feed, radio, SiriusXM or podcast live calls.

league_audio.name: NWSL Radio (iHeartRadio)
league_audio.what: HISTORICAL (2021): NWSL and iHeartMedia launched free live play-by-play of the 2 biggest games each week on an iHeartRadio station called NWSL Radio. Not confirmed active for 2025/2026.
